questions.question: Which three disciples did Jesus lead up a high mountain by themselves?
On a high mountain, Jesus' clothes became whiter than anyone on earth could bleach them. True or false?
On a high mountain, a voice from a cloud said, "This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!" Who was the voice talking about?
As Jesus and three disciples came down the mountain, what did He tell them to do about what they had seen?

answers.text: Tell no one until the Son of Man has risen from the dead
Tell the other disciples as soon as they get back down
Tell the crowds in every village they pass through
